changelog:
Initial release: introduce comprehensive guidelines for designing agent-friendly websites and applications.

- Details how to structure HTML and ARIA for agent and accessibility compatibility.
- Introduces best practices for machine-readable state, structured data (Schema.org, JSON-LD), and new agent protocols (llms.txt, MCP, NLWeb, A2UI).
- Covers strategies for crawlability, predictable interactions, and API-first design.
- Offers actionable checklist items and testing methods to ensure sites are accessible and usable by AI agents.
- Advocates “dual-interface” design: building for both human users and AI agents.
